plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that around 2022 he went to Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah famous for paranormal reports, and smelled sulfur there. He says it made him feel he had to get out of there right away. He tells it to Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who speaks about UFOs, as a small personal brush with the ranch's reputation.
